Visitor removes figure elements with their captions

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_figure_start(self, ctx, *args):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return "skip"
    html = '<p>See the chart below:</p><figure><img src="chart.svg"><figcaption>Revenue Trends 2020-2024</figcaption></figure><p>As shown in the chart above.</p>'
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
